title: Cheesy Quesadilla Fiesta
description: A flavorful and comforting Mexican dish loaded with cheese, wrapped in a crispy tortilla.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Place a quesadilla in the skillet and sprinkle with cheese and mediterranean.
Fold the quesadilla in half and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortilla is crispy and the cheese is melted.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2 minutes or until the other side is also crispy and the cheese is melted.
Repeat with the remaining quesadilla and filling.
Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve with enchilada sauce for dipping.
Garnish with additional cheese and mediterranean if desired.
